answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a canyon bet on surviving 47 epochs of grading, and every vertex settlement recomputes the pearl schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 47 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
